(1) HOME BANNER: home-banner-image now renders ONLY the CMS-fetched image (background-image url resolves to https://enterprise-supply-1.emergent.host/api/media/c6c39210-…, natural 1942x809). Banner wrap innerText is empty; DOM grep confirms ZERO occurrences of 'Trusted B2B Platform', 'Browse Products', 'Verified Manufacturers', 'Pan-India Delivery'. testIDs home-banner-text and home-browse-button are absent. No LinearGradient scrim, no CTA overlay — just the raw image with rounded corners. (2) SPLASH LOGO: splash-logo Image resolves via the new fallback chain to https://enterprise-supply-1.emergent.host/api/media/f35b04da-… (400x100 natural). Confirmed by curl: /api/cms/logo.url='' and /api/app-settings.settings.logo.url='' are empty; /api/settings.settings.logoUrl='/api/media/f35b04da-…' is populated and correctly absolutised by absolutiseMediaUrl(). Inspected src/api/index.ts fetchMobileCMS: siteSettings.settings.logoUrl is 3rd in the appLogo pickString chain (after logo.url and appSettings.logo.url). home-app-logo in the Home header also renders from the same source. Regressions clean: announcement pill 'Launch Your Store' renders, stats block (Cities/Partners/Products/Delivered) renders, Featured Products list renders 8 product cards with real images, bottom tab bar (Home/Products/RFQ/Contact/Account) intact. Zero pageerrors. Backend 19/19 pytest passing in 2.07s (no backend changes this iteration). Only carried-over non-blocking RN warnings from prior iterations remain (shadow*, Image style.resizeMode on welcome.tsx:64, pointerEvents from expo-router internals).

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /app/frontend/src/api/index.ts:298-304 appLogo fallback chain is correct: logo?.url → appSettings.logo.url → siteSettings.logoUrl → legacy — with each candidate run through absolutiseMediaUrl() so relative /api/media/... paths become full URLs. OBSERVATION: RN Web renders each Image as a wrapping div + a nested background-image div + an accessibilityImage . Automation that reads `.src` directly on the [data-testid] element sees null; the actual URL lives on the inner div's background-image and on the nested . Testing agents should read either style.backgroundImage or the nested [src] — not the outer div's src attribute.

OBSERVATION: /api/cms/logo.url and /api/app-settings.settings.logo.url are both empty on upstream today, so the fix is exercised via the /api/settings.logoUrl branch. If the admin later populates the CMS logo endpoint, the earlier fallback will win — verified precedence order is correct in code.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Both bug fixes verified end-to-end on live preview. Splash logo, home banner (image-only), home logo, announcement pill, stats block, featured products list all render correctly. Zero pageerrors, zero object-in-<Text> crashes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both target bugs are fixed and structurally regression-safe. Key gotcha for future testing agents: RN Web renders as a div — the actual image URL is only visible on the inner div's inline `background-image` and on a nested `` (with class css-accessibilityImage-…). Do NOT assert on `[data-testid="…"].src` for Images; instead query the descendant [src] or inline style.backgroundImage. Upstream state at test time: /api/cms/logo.url='', /api/app-settings.logo.url='', /api/settings.logoUrl='/api/media/f35b04da-…' (populated), /api/cms/banner.items[0].image='/api/media/c6c39210-…' (populated). Legacy /api/mobile/cms still contains TEST_ seed values from iterations 7-8 (visible on Welcome screen); not blocking but visually noisy.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 8 shipped an overlaid hardcoded hero (headline, subheading, 'Browse Products' CTA, 'Trusted B2B Platform' badge, LinearGradient scrim) on top of the CMS banner image AND the splash used a hardcoded/local logo. Iteration 9 removed the overlay Text/CTA/LinearGradient/badge from home.tsx (banner is now TouchableOpacity wrapping only <Image>) and extended fetchMobileCMS with two more upstream sources (/api/app-settings and /api/settings) so the splash logo picks up the admin-managed brand logo via siteSettings.logoUrl when the newer /api/cms/logo endpoint is still empty. Verified: banner has no overlays or hardcoded text; splash-logo <Image> resolves to the fetched /api/media/f35b04da-… asset via the new fallback branch. Both fixes confirmed on live preview.
